name: spectral_s1_pilot
status: later-pass corrected design; no seed drawn
observable: q_v(t) = [P^(2t)]_vv, simple random walk, uniform sources without replacement, annealed mean before logs (S0 section 2)

kernel.R_rule: double until killed mass at 2T <= eta * q_R(2T) or R >= 2T

seed_rule: np.random.SeedSequence([seed_base, i_family, i_size, i_rep]) with PCG64; sources from a child of the same sequence (as D2)

stop_gates.P0b: killed-ball vs S0 full kernel <= 1e-12; bracket contains exact
stop_gates.P0c: Z2 torus within certified bracket of S0 Fourier

decision_rule.variance_projection: tree-level influence variance of annealed slope; chi-square df=7 approximate upper 95% limit; S=32 fixed
decision_rule.size_equivalence_rule: CI fully within [-0.03, 0.03], NOT merely containing zero
decision_rule.headroom_applies: all sampled sources at each window t_hi

budget.timing_projection: unknown until measured; edge-step operation count is not a wall-time benchmark

statistics.unreliable_projection: sample skew abs > 1.5 OR max squared-influence share > 0.5 OR mean return <= 0 OR influence variance=0 => no GO
